subject.title: [Bug]: All channels enter broken state after 2026.6.11 update — one message per session then permanent silence

question: Should this broad v2026.6.11 all-channel incident stay open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365, or successor fixes, are correlated with stable-package proof, or should it be split now under narrower trackers?
rationale: The remaining evidence spans release packaging, shared session recovery, WebChat dispatch, and WhatsApp durable replay; deterministic cleanup cannot decide the canonical incident boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the reply-session self-heal and durable replay fixes are reviewed, landed or rejected, and verified against the next stable package.

options.title: Split Under Narrow Canonicals
options.body: Move each remaining slice to the narrower open issue or PR and close this only after maintainers confirm every slice has an owner and proof target.

options.title: Treat As Reply-Init Duplicate
options.body: Close this under the reply-session-init conflict tracker only if maintainers decide that conflict fully explains the WebChat and WhatsApp symptoms, including duplicate replies.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Incident Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the reply-session self-heal and durable replay fixes are reviewed, landed or rejected, and verified against the next stable package.

likelyOwner.reason: The central unresolved choice crosses the session-accessor and reply-session initialization boundary where jalehman has the strongest recent merged history.
